title: 선주상호보험조합법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 3 (Business Method) The business method, as defined in Article 14(2)(2) of the Act, must include the following items:

1. Scope of insurance and insurance contracts
2. Matters related to special provisions in insurance contracts
3. Matters related to the authority of affiliated offices
4. Matters related to limitations on insurance amounts and insurance periods
5. Matters related to the conclusion of insurance contracts
6. Matters related to the collection of insurance premiums, payment of insurance claims, and the refund of insurance premiums and refunds
7. Forms and accompanying documents for insurance policies and applications, and their forms
8. Matters related to reinsurance
9. Matters related to the management of cooperative assets
